remarks: Desirable Chesterfield community, ideally located in the heart of Stamford. This bright and spacious 2 bedroom, 2 bath townhouse offers an open, loft-inspired layout enhanced by soaring vaulted ceilings, skylights, and abundant natural light. Just professionally painted throughout, the home features beautifully refinished hardwood floors on the main level, new hardwood flooring in the bedroom, and an updated bath with a new vanity. Sliding doors extend the living space outdoors, while in-unit laundry adds everyday convenience. Additional highlights include a private storage unit (#32) and reserved covered garage parking (#28). Chesterfield residents enjoy 24-hour guard, two community pools, and a clubhouse, all just moments from Ridgeway Shopping Center, dining, transportation, and major highways.
